about.title: Designing Dream Interiors
paragraphs: GAC Door Handles is the #1 interior design business in the Middle East. We offer custom-made brass door handles and accessories with a variety of finishes to fit any room design.
Our pieces are masterfully crafted and designed to be both elegant and durable. Each handle reflects decades of artisanal tradition combined with contemporary design sensibility.
